# Types

Every table shape the API returns or accepts: 221 types. A field ending in `?` may be missing. Wrapped game objects (`RimPawn`, `RimThing`, `RimMap`, `RimFaction`, `RimObject`) are userdata with properties and methods, described in [naming](naming.md) and the [reference](reference.md). Every function that takes a pawn, thing, map or faction accepts the wrapped object or its integer handle.

## Aliases

| Alias | Means |
|-------|-------|
| `RimMapRef` | `RimMap\|integer` |
| `RimPawnRef` | `RimPawn\|RimEntity\|integer` |

### RimAbilityInfo

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `def` | `string` | Def name of the ability |
| `label?` | `string` | Name shown to the player |
| `level` | `integer` | Level the ability needs |
| `can_cast` | `boolean` | Whether the pawn can cast it now |
| `cooldown_ticks` | `integer` | Ticks until it can be cast again |

### RimArea

A rectangle of cells, both corners inclusive.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `x1` | `integer` | West edge, cell x |
| `z1` | `integer` | South edge, cell z |
| `x2` | `integer` | East edge, cell x |
| `z2` | `integer` | North edge, cell z |

Used by `RimThingQuery.area`, `RimPawnQuery.area`.

### RimHookCallReplace

Extends [RimHookOptions](#rimhookoptions).

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `type` | `string` | Method whose body is rewritten. |
| `method` | `string` | Name of the method whose body is rewritten |
| `call` | `string` | "Type.Method" of the call to replace. |
| `call_sig` | `string[]|nil` | Parameter type names of the call to replace |
| `nth` | `integer|nil` | Replace only the nth match. 0 or nil replaces all. |
| `fn` | `fun(ctx:RimHookCtx):any` | Return nil to run the original call. |

### RimHookCtx

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `method` | `string` | Full name of the patched method. |
| `phase` | `"prefix"|"postfix"|"finalizer"|"replace_call"` | Which part of the call this is |
| `pawn` | `RimPawn|nil` | The pawn the call is about, when there is one |
| `instance` | `RimPawn|RimThing|RimObject|nil` | The object the method is called on |
| `args` | `any[]` | Arguments, 1 based. |
| `named` | `table<string,` | any> Arguments by parameter name. |
| `arg_names` | `string[]` | Parameter names, in order |
| `arg_modes` | `("in"|"ref"|"out")[]` | For each parameter: in, ref or out |
| `has_result` | `boolean` | Whether the method returns a value |
| `result` | `any` | Return value of the method (absent for void). |
| `exception` | `string|nil` | Finalizer only. |
| `state` | `any` | Value stored with set_state in an earlier phase of this call. |

### RimHookIds

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `prefix` | `integer|nil` | Id of the prefix hook, to pass to game.hooks.remove |
| `postfix` | `integer|nil` | Id of the postfix hook |
| `finalizer` | `integer|nil` | Id of the finalizer hook |

### RimHookOptions

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `sig` | `string[]|nil` | Parameter type names selecting one overload ("int", "Verse.DamageInfo", "System.Int32&"). |
| `priority` | `integer|nil` | Harmony priority, higher runs first. Default 400. |
| `before` | `string[]|nil` | Mod ids whose hooks this one must run before |
| `after` | `string[]|nil` | Mod ids whose hooks this one must run after |

### RimHookPatch

Extends [RimHookOptions](#rimhookoptions).

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `type` | `string` | Full name of the type to patch |
| `method` | `string` | Name of the method to patch |
| `prefix` | `fun(ctx:RimHookCtx):boolean|nil` | Runs before the method, return false to skip it |
| `postfix` | `fun(ctx:RimHookCtx)` | Runs after the method |
| `finalizer` | `fun(ctx:RimHookCtx)` | Runs after the method even when it threw |

### RimPatchOp

One XML patch operation. op is add, replace, remove, insert, set_attribute, add_attribute, remove_attribute, test, conditional, sequence, if_mod or add_mod_extension.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `op` | `string` | Operation name, such as add or replace |
| `xpath?` | `string` | XPath of the nodes it changes |
| `value?` | `string` | table XML text or a table |
| `attribute?` | `string` | Attribute name for attribute operations |
| `order?` | `string` | Append or Prepend |
| `mods?` | `string[]` | if_mod |
| `match?` | [RimPatchOp[]](#rimpatchop) | Operations to run when the condition matches |
| `nomatch?` | [RimPatchOp[]](#rimpatchop) | Operations to run when it does not |
| `ops?` | [RimPatchOp[]](#rimpatchop) | sequence |
| `success?` | `string` | Always, Invert or Normal |

Used by `game.patch.build`, `game.patch.write`.

| `priority` | `integer` | 0 means off, 1 is highest |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Incapable of the work |

Returned by `game.pawns.work_priorities`.

### RimWorkTypeInfo

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|-------|------|---------|
| `def` | `string` | Def name of the work type |
| `label?` | `string` | Name shown to the player |
| `order` | `integer` | Sort order, lower comes first |
| `always_on` | `boolean` | Whether the work type cannot be turned off |
| `givers` | `string[]` | Work giver defs in priority order |

Returned by `game.ai.work_types`.

Returned by `game.generation.features`.

| `objects` | `integer` | How many world objects exist |
| `settlements` | `integer` | How many settlements exist |
| `caravans` | `integer` | How many caravans exist |
| `maps` | `integer` | How many maps are loaded |

| Field | Type | Meaning |
